title: Amazingly Crunchy Greek Chicken Kebabs
description: A Whole30-friendly Greek dish featuring panang curry paste and a salt-bake crust, this recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner, with a briny and crunchy texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together panang curry paste, lemon juice, olive oil, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry paste mixture.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken pieces in a single layer.
Sprinkle the salt evenly over the chicken pieces to form a crust.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and crunchy.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill if desired.
